def solve5cap3(G,start,t0,goal):
    NR=len(G);NC=len(G[0]); P=140
    def ok(r,c): return 0<=r<NR and 0<=c<NC and G[r][c]!='B'
    NM={(-2,0):'UP',(2,0):'DOWN',(0,-2):'LEFT',(0,2):'RIGHT'}
    s0=(start,t0%P,15); dq=deque([(s0,[])]); seen={s0}
    while dq:
        ((r,c),tm,al),path=dq.popleft()
        if (r,c)==goal: return path
        for (dr,dc),nm in NM.items():
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc; ntm=(tm+1)%P
            if not ok(r+dr//2,c+dc//2) or not ok(nr,nc): continue
            cap=[i for i in range(4) if (al>>i&1) and W[i][1](tm)==(nr,nc)]
            nal=al
            for i in cap: nal &= ~(1<<i)
            if (nr,nc) in occset(ntm,nal): continue
            s2=((nr,nc),ntm,nal)
            if s2 in seen: continue
            seen.add(s2); dq.append((s2,path+[nm]+(['CAP%d'%i for i in cap] if cap else [])))
    return None

def sim(ends,hi,clicks,label):
    e=list(ends); h=hi; out=[]
    for c_ in clicks:
        if c_==e[h]: continue

    print(label,'hubs:',[x[1] for x in out])
    print(label,'ends',e,'hub',mean_of(e),'handle idx',h)

def render_placement(P,S,k,dr,dc):
    bb = rot(objs[P]['body'],k); rb = rot(objs[P]['red'],k)
    mb = {(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in bb}; mr={(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in rb}
    Sb=objs[S]['body']; Sr=objs[S]['red']
    rows = sorted({p[0] for p in mb|mr|Sb|Sr}); cols=sorted({p[1] for p in mb|mr|Sb|Sr})
    r0,r1=min(rows),max(rows); c0,c1=min(cols),max(cols)
    out=[]
    for r_ in range(r0,r1+1):
        line=''
        for c_ in range(c0,c1+1):
            ch='.'
            if (r_,c_) in Sb: ch='S'
            if (r_,c_) in Sr: ch='r'
            if (r_,c_) in mb: ch='P'
            if (r_,c_) in mr: ch='#'
            line+=ch
        out.append(f'{r_:2d} '+line)
    print(f'--- {P} rot{k} -> {S} at ({dr},{dc})  bbox rows {r0}-{r1} cols {c0}-{c1}')
    print('\n'.join(out))

def solve(G, start, goal, guards):
    NR=len(G); NC=len(G[0])
    def ok(r,c): return 0<=r<NR and 0<=c<NC and G[r][c]!='B'
    gset=frozenset(guards)
    def danger(pos,gs):
        r,c=pos
        return any((gr==r and abs(gc-c)<=2) for (gr,gc) in gs)
    start_state=(start,gset)
    dq=deque([(start_state,[])]); seen={start_state}
    while dq:
        ((r,c),gs),path=dq.popleft()
        if (r,c)==goal: return path
        for dr,dc in ((-2,0),(2,0),(0,-2),(0,2)):
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if not ok(r+dr//2,c+dc//2) or not ok(nr,nc): continue
            ngs = gs - {(nr,nc)}   # capture if landing on a guard
            if danger((nr,nc), ngs): continue
            s2=((nr,nc),ngs)
            if s2 in seen: continue
            seen.add(s2); dq.append((s2,path+[('UDLR'[[ -2,0,2,0,0,-2,0,2][i*2:i*2+2]==(dr,dc)][0] if False else {(-2,0):'UP',(2,0):'DOWN',(0,-2):'LEFT',(0,2):'RIGHT'}[(dr,dc)])]))
    return None
